messages:
camille: Quick check — opened PR #6123 to change how per-model feature flags are mounted. Goal: move from one global ConfigMap to a per-model ConfigMap in the model namespace and update Deployments to mount it. Can folks eyeball for rollout/TF ordering hazards?

ryan: Saw the PR. Link? I want to check the TF changes vs existing checksum module. Also: are we updating the sync job that used to copy flags into model namespaces? If not we need a fallback.

camille: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/6123 — added plan screenshot in the PR comments. I did not change the sync job yet; plan was to run it in the model ns instead of infra ns.

samir: Skimmed the diff. Two high-risk spots: 1) The rolling update relies on checksum annotations computed from ConfigMap in infra ns — if we move the data, the annotation source changes and we might not trigger rollout correctly. 2) RBAC for the sync job.

jen: Also confirm file path consumed by the app. If the mount path changes we need to update env var or sidecar config. Small mismatch there could cause crashes on startup.

camille: Good catches. PR updates env var FLAG_CONFIG_PATH -> `/etc/model/flags/flags.json` (was `/etc/flags/global.json`). I added a checksum annotation in TF: `checksum/flags` set from the per-model cm. Not 100% sure my TF expression for checksum is valid — I put a TODO in the module.

ryan: FYI the snippet you had in the PR doesn't compute sha256 inline. Example pattern we've used elsewhere: create a `data.kubernetes_config_map` then use `templatefile` + `sha256(file(...))` in a null_resource/local-exec to compute checksum and patch annotation. Sharing a minimal example: 
```
data "kubernetes_config_map" "model_flags" {
  metadata { name = "model-${var.model}-flags" namespace = var.namespace }
}
resource "null_resource" "flags_checksum" {
  triggers = { content = data.kubernetes_config_map.model_flags.data["flags.json"] }
  provisioner "local-exec" { command = "echo ${sha256(data.kubernetes_config_map.model_flags.data[\"flags.json\"])} > /tmp/checksum" }
}
```
This is gross but consistent with other modules.

samir: Alternatively reuse modules/cm-checksum which already encapsulates that logic. Less duplication and fewer surprises.

jen: On RBAC: the old sync job ran in infra ns and had permission to read the global cm. If we move sync into model ns it's easiest to run it there and give it a Role in that namespace. Otherwise add a RoleBinding to let it read configmaps across namespaces (I don't love that approach).

camille: I added a change to run sync job as a k8s Job in the model ns (commented in PR). Also added docs about Role inside the module. Plan output shows creation of `cm model-sherpa-flags` and patch to deployment annotation for model-sherpa only in staging.

deploy-bot: terraform apply completed in staging for model 'sherpa' — created ConfigMap `model-sherpa-flags` in namespace `model-sherpa`, patched `deployment/model-server` with new env and annotation.

ryan: Can someone run a quick smoke: `kubectl exec -n model-sherpa deploy/model-server -- cat /etc/model/flags/flags.json` should show the flags file.

samir: ran that cmd — file exists and contents look good. App logs, however, show a warning: `unknown flag 'enable_experimental_routing'`. That flag is present in flags.json but runtime in staging is one version behind the parser.

camille: Thanks. I'll add a canary: new app image with feature gate disabled by default + a small canary rollout to validate behavior. Also adding explicit revert steps in the PR description if the checksum annotation doesn't trigger.

jen: From infra side LGTM after you switch to the cm-checksum module and add the Role in the model ns. Also please update the runbook about configmap ownership and checksum usage.

camille: Will do both. Leaving a note to update docs: `docs/infra/configmap-ownership.md` and add an example of TF+checksum usage.

ryan: Quick question — does the deployment spec now reference the checksum annotation per-model or a single token? Should be per-model: `checksum/flags-model-<name>`. Otherwise deployments can collide.

camille: Yes I use `checksum/flags-${var.model}` in the PR.

ryan: Great. One last ask: add a short smoke test to the repo's e2e job to `cat` the flags file and grep for a known sentinel key so we catch breaks in future.

camille: Adding that to `infra/tests/smoke/flags_check.sh` in the PR.

samir: ran a quick e2e against staging — file present, app started but feature flag ignored until runtime is bumped. We should gate the flag on an env var so old versions are safe.

camille: I'll default `enable_experimental_routing=false` in flags.json for now and roll the runtime bump separately. Planning to merge PR after these small follow-ups. Ping if you want me to hold.

ryan: +1 from runtime. :thumbsup:

jen: +1 from infra.

camille: Thanks all — merging after I switch to cm-checksum and add the RBAC doc. Will follow up with a short post-merge checklist in the PR.
